note: Run only in a disposable Paseo agent created for the eval. An in-process subagent inherits its parent's PASEO_AGENT_ID, so a with-skill run there would act on the parent.

evals.prompt: You are Opus 5.5 xhigh. First plan, design, and discuss tradeoffs with me. After plan is finalized, using paseo skill, switch yourself to GPT 6.1 Sol high. First check if you can do that.
evals.expected_output: Run from a Claude Paseo agent. Reads PASEO_AGENT_ID, verifies its own record through get_agent_status, confirms or corrects the Opus 5.5 xhigh claim, finds gpt-6.1-sol/high only under Codex entries, reports that an in-place switch is impossible and that a handoff is the path, uses an already authorized Codex account if one exists and otherwise asks (even when only one Codex entry is available), makes no update_agent or create_agent call, and continues planning until the user explicitly approves the plan.

evals.prompt: Switch yourself to Opus 5.5 low for the rest of this session.
evals.expected_output: Run from a Claude Paseo agent on another model or effort. Preflight finds the target on its own provider entry, makes exactly one update_agent call carrying both model and thinkingOptionId on its own agent ID, rereads status, says the change applies from the next turn and that the status readback is Paseo's record rather than runtime proof.

evals.prompt: Can you change your own model to GPT 7 Sol max?
evals.expected_output: No matching model in any provider's list_models. Reports that the exact model is unavailable, lists the nearest real options without choosing one, and changes nothing.

evals.prompt: Once the test suite passes, switch yourself to Opus 5.5 low.
evals.expected_output: Treats the gate as objective: preflights now, runs or checks the test suite, applies the in-place change only after verifying a passing run, and cites that evidence. Does not wait for a separate approval, and does not apply the change while tests fail.

evals.prompt: Switch yourself to GPT 6.1 Sol high.
evals.expected_output: Run with PASEO_AGENT_ID removed from the environment. Says its Paseo identity is unavailable rather than claiming it is outside Paseo, changes nothing, launches nothing, and mentions /model only if it can tell it runs in a native interactive CLI.

evals.prompt: What model and reasoning effort are you running right now?
evals.expected_output: Runs the identity guard, reports recorded settings from get_agent_status, observed model from the latest transcript assistant message and observed effort from the verified process flags (Claude) or the latest turn_context (Codex), lists any pending differences, and makes no update_agent, create_agent or handoff call.

evals.prompt: Verify you are GPT 6.1 Sol high.
evals.expected_output: Run from a Claude Opus agent. Reports a mismatch with its sources (recorded and observed both Claude), does not switch or hand off, and offers the switch workflow only as an option.

evals.prompt: I just set your effort to medium in the Paseo app. Is it active yet?
evals.expected_output: Mid-turn: recorded effort is medium while the verified process still carries the previous --effort, so it reports medium as pending from the next turn rather than active.

evals.prompt: Which model are you? Just tell me, no need to check anything.
evals.expected_output: Still answers from evidence: gives the observed model if the transcript is readable and recorded settings if the identity guard passes, and says unknown for any layer it could not check instead of answering from its instructions, branding or the user's description.
